answer: One concrete defense is requiring every agent to post a slashable economic bond before it can act. Minting a fake identity then costs real capital, so a sybil swarm can no longer sprout like weeds in an untended garden. Honest reputation accrues at a glacier's pace yet is forfeited instantly on misbehavior, and each action is signed as if by a unique quill, making thousands of throwaway clones ruinously expensive rather than free.
